question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority within the Chinese Communist Party, backed by loyalists across the Politburo and military, underpins trader consensus that removal before 2027 remains unlikely. No verified challenges, purges of rivals, or health disclosures have materialized to shift elite dynamics since mid-2025 rumors of decline or absence from events like the BRICS summit proved unsubstantiated. Analysts note the absence of an appointed successor and institutional reforms that favor continuity through at least a fourth term. Realistic scenarios that could still alter outcomes include an abrupt health event forcing incapacity, a severe economic or military crisis eroding elite support, or unexpected internal factional realignment ahead of the 2027 Party Congress, though current evidence shows no such catalysts.
